gpc.basis: In-service years of the current Georgia Power projects in the SERTP 2024, 2025 and 2026 Preliminary Expansion Plan Reports (Non-CEII); year precision

notes: DESC: a project is compared when it appears in at least two of the 2023-2027 ... 2026-2030 editions; shift = latest minus earliest planned in-service date.
Georgia Power: SERTP lists in-service years only, so shifts are whole years; only projects in the current dataset (confirmed in Georgia) are followed, matched by the same named sites.
Projects that drop out of a later DESC edition are usually completed; they keep their last planned date.
